intent: Teach each-animal needs, daily pet care, patient back-door waiting, sunlight sleeping, puppy and mouse identification, kitten size sufficiency and rabbit disappearance into a hedge.
picturePurpose: Original young-animal/biological-mouse/computer-mouse comparison plus five reversible condition diagrams and one exact evidence selection; no illustrated action substitutes for reading the source.

workshop.title: 看动物，读准它的动作
workshop.instruction: 安排每天的照料，改变位置与大小，再用句中线索辨认动物。

items.prompt: each说每一个。它们需要同一种住处，还是适合各自的住处？
items.after: needs a suitable place to live.
items.reason: Each animal逐个说每只动物；suitable是适宜，不等于所有动物住处相同。
items.hint: each后接单数animal，直接说Each animal，不加an。
items.material: Each animal needs a suitable place to live.

options.text: 每只动物都需要适宜的住处。
options.reason: 保留Each animal与suitable place to live。

options.text: 所有动物必须住在同一种环境里。
options.reason: 同一种扩大了suitable适宜的意思。

options.text: 只有少数动物需要住处。
options.reason: 少数改变了Each每一个。

wordDecision.prompt: each说每一个。它们需要同一种住处，还是适合各自的住处？

transfer.passage:
三条新信息
狗耐心地在前门旁等候。我们的猫在一小片阴影里睡觉。一只兔子从树篱里出来了。
词语提示：shade 阴影；come out of 从……里出来。

options.text: The dog waited patiently by the back door. Our cat sleeps in a patch of shade. A rabbit came out of the hedge.
The dog waited patiently by the front door. Our cat sleeps in a patch of sunlight. A rabbit came out of the hedge.
The dog waited patiently by the front door. Our cat sleeps in a patch of shade. A rabbit disappeared into the hedge.
The dog waited patiently by the front door. Our cat sleeps in a patch of shade. A rabbit came out of the hedge.

answer.display: The dog waited patiently by the front door. Our cat sleeps in a patch of shade. A rabbit came out of the hedge.

explanation.strategy: 分别核对门的位置、光照条件与兔子的进出方向。

steps.reason: front是前，by仍是旁边，patiently耐心地保留。

steps.text: 阴影里睡觉：sleeps in a patch of shade。
从树篱里出来：came out of the hedge。
steps.reason: out of是从里面出来，与into进入方向相反。

distractors.reason: disappeared into把出来改成钻进去不见。

explanation.pitfall: 熟悉动物名也要读新条件；不要把原句的back、sunlight和into带进来。

visual.title: 三条新条件
visual.caption: 位置、光照和方向分别核对，不补动物年龄、数量或等待时间。
